description: List the products that drew the most community reaction recently — use it to see what is trending among products launched since ChatGPT's release, or what is trending for a kind of tool (pass need). Ranked by a reaction index computed only from the sources' own numbers: each post reaction (e.g. HN points, Product Hunt votes) is compared with the same source's reactions from the last 14 days (the share it beats, 0–1); a GitHub repository counts by the stars it gained in the period against its own pace over the 28 days before (the fastest get 1 and down); a product's best value per source is added up. Tangerine Index does not rate products. period_days is 3, 7 (default), or 30; data refreshes once a day (as_of). Each result shows the reactions that counted, with each source's raw number.

forms.description: Only return products that have ALL of these forms

need.description: Optional: narrow to products that do this, in short plain English, e.g. "coding agent"

open_source.description: true: only open-source products (GitHub repositories); false: only the others

period_days.description: Look at reactions posted in the last 3, 7 (default), or 30 days

name: trending_products

as_of.description: When the data was last collected (ISO 8601, UTC). Updated once a day.

link_status.description: 'dead' means the product link did not respond when last checked

page_url.description: Tangerine Index page for this product

reaction_index.description: Sum over sources of the product's best reaction in the period, each as the share (0–1) of that source's reactions from the last 14 days it beats

score.description: Number reported by the source (HN: points). Never combined across sources.

score_unit.description: Unit of score in this source, e.g. 'pts'

summary.description: What it does, one line, in the original English

title: Trending products
